extracted.name: Flavorful Flounder for the Oven
extracted.description: Simple baked and broiled flounder dish cooked in lemon juice and topped with a golden-brown crust of mayo, Parmesan cheese, and green onions.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds flounder fillets, rinsed and patted dry
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with nonstick spray.
Season flounder fillets on both sides with salt. Place into the prepared baking dish and brush with 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
Mix Parmesan, melted butter, mayonnaise, green onions, and remaining 2 tablespoons lemon juice together in a bowl. Spoon mixture over fillets.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Turn on the broiler and broil until fillets are just browned on top, 3 to 5 minutes.
